title: A 30-second 3D animated short film in the style of a Pixar/Dreamworks feature —…
content:
A 30-second 3D animated short film in the style of a Pixar/Dreamworks feature — expressive squash-and-stretch character animation, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, rich saturated colors, soft volumetric light, and highly detailed feather and environment rendering.

CHARACTERS: PERCIVAL, a magnificent proud peacock with shimmering iridescent blue-green tail feathers that fan out dramatically, glossy and perfectly groomed, theatrical expressions, aristocratic posture. PIP, a small scruffy brown sparrow with messy feathers, bright confident eyes, quick bouncy movements.

SETTING: A golden-hour sunlit forest path after rain. A large glistening muddy puddle blocks the trail, reflecting the sky. Lush greenery, god rays through trees, floating pollen particles, wet leaves sparkling.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:04) — WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT: Slow cinematic dolly-in along the forest path. Percival struts into frame in slow motion, tail fanning open like a royal cape, feathers catching the sunlight. Triumphant orchestral sting. He stops abruptly at the edge of the huge muddy puddle. Camera crash-zooms onto his horrified face.

PERCIVAL (appalled, posh accent): "A puddle?! On MY path?!"

SHOT 2 (0:04–0:10) — LOW ANGLE, over-the-puddle shot: The camera sits low across the water, making the puddle look like an ocean. Percival circles it anxiously, lifting each foot delicately, grimacing. Extreme close-up on his immaculate tail feathers quivering at the mere sight of mud.

PERCIVAL: "I can't cross THAT! Do you know how long these feathers take to dry?!"

SHOT 3 (0:10–0:15) — WHIP PAN to Pip the sparrow landing on a nearby branch, ruffled and chirpy. Pip looks at the puddle, looks at Percival, shrugs.

PIP (cheerful, cockney energy): "It's two feet wide, mate."

SHOT 4 (0:15–0:19) — DYNAMIC TRACKING SHOT: Pip takes a running start and hops clean over the puddle in one joyful bounce — slow-motion mid-air moment, mud droplets sparkling around him, then lands perfectly on the other side and keeps walking without breaking stride. Percival watches, beak open in disbelief.

SHOT 5 (0:19–0:24) — WIDE SHOT, dramatic angle: Percival begins the long walk AROUND the puddle — the camera pulls up and back in a sweeping crane shot revealing his absurdly long detour through bushes, over a log, past a confused family of ducks. Epic adventure music swells ironically.

PERCIVAL (marching, huffy): "A gentleman NEVER rushes!"

SHOT 6 (0:24–0:28) — NIGHT FALLS. The same spot, now moonlit, fireflies glowing, crickets. Percival finally arrives, exhausted, feathers drooping, one leaf stuck to his head. Pip is already there, fast asleep in a cozy nest, snoring softly, one eye opening.

PIP (sleepy, deadpan): "Longer than the walk, apparently."

SHOT 7 (0:28–0:30) — FINAL CLOSE-UP: Percival stares directly into camera, deadpan, tail feathers wilting one by one like a deflating balloon. Comedic trombone sting. Title card appears in elegant gold lettering over the moonlit puddle: "Don't let looking good stop you from getting there."

AUDIO DESIGN: playful orchestral score with comedic timing, bouncy pizzicato strings for Pip, pompous brass for Percival, exaggerated cartoon footsteps, splashes, feather rustles, and a record-scratch when Percival sees the puddle. Expressive character voice acting with big comedic performances.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: anamorphic lens flares on the feathers, warm golden-hour color grade shifting to cool blue moonlight, shallow focus character close-ups, confident comedic camera movement, clean composition with strong silhouettes. Ultra-detailed subsurface scattering on feathers and wet mud, Pixar-quality rendering, 4K, 24fps cinematic motion.

es.content:
Un cortometraje animado en 3D de 30 segundos al estilo de una película de Pixar/DreamWorks — animación de personajes expresiva con squash-and-stretch, iluminación cinematográfica, poca profundidad de campo, colores ricos y saturados, luz volumétrica suave y renderizado altamente detallado de las plumas y del entorno.

CHARACTERS: PERCIVAL, un magnífico y orgulloso pavo real con brillantes plumas de la cola iridiscentes azul verdosas que se abren de forma dramática, lustroso y perfectamente arreglado, expresiones teatrales, postura aristocrática. PIP, un pequeño gorrión marrón desaliñado con plumas revueltas, ojos brillantes y seguros, movimientos rápidos y saltarines.

SETTING: Un sendero forestal iluminado por la luz dorada del atardecer después de la lluvia. Un gran charco de barro reluciente bloquea el camino, reflejando el cielo. Vegetación exuberante, rayos de luz entre los árboles, partículas de polen flotando, hojas mojadas brillando.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:04) — WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT: Lento dolly-in cinematográfico a lo largo del sendero del bosque. Percival entra en cuadro pavoneándose en cámara lenta, con la cola abriéndose como una capa real, mientras las plumas captan la luz del sol. Golpe orquestal triunfal. Se detiene bruscamente al borde del enorme charco de barro. La cámara hace un crash-zoom hacia su rostro horrorizado.

PERCIVAL (appalled, posh accent): "A puddle?! On MY path?!"

SHOT 2 (0:04–0:10) — LOW ANGLE, over-the-puddle shot: La cámara se sitúa baja, al otro lado del agua, haciendo que el charco parezca un océano. Percival lo rodea con ansiedad, levantando cada pata con delicadeza, haciendo una mueca. Primerísimo primer plano de sus impecables plumas de la cola temblando solo con ver el barro.

PERCIVAL: "I can't cross THAT! Do you know how long these feathers take to dry?!"

SHOT 3 (0:10–0:15) — WHIP PAN hacia Pip, el gorrión, que aterriza en una rama cercana, despeinado y alegre. Pip mira el charco, mira a Percival y se encoge de hombros.

PIP (cheerful, cockney energy): "It's two feet wide, mate."

SHOT 4 (0:15–0:19) — DYNAMIC TRACKING SHOT: Pip toma impulso corriendo y salta limpio sobre el charco en un solo rebote alegre — momento en cámara lenta en el aire, con gotas de barro brillando a su alrededor, luego aterriza perfectamente al otro lado y sigue caminando sin perder el ritmo. Percival lo observa, con el pico abierto de incredulidad.

SHOT 5 (0:19–0:24) — WIDE SHOT, dramatic angle: Percival empieza la larga caminata ALREDEDOR del charco — la cámara se eleva y se aleja en una amplia toma de grúa revelando su desvío absurdamente largo a través de arbustos, sobre un tronco, pasando junto a una familia de patos confundida. La música épica de aventura crece irónicamente.

PERCIVAL (marching, huffy): "A gentleman NEVER rushes!"

SHOT 6 (0:24–0:28) — NIGHT FALLS. El mismo lugar, ahora iluminado por la luna, con luciérnagas brillando y grillos. Percival por fin llega, exhausto, con las plumas caídas y una hoja pegada a la cabeza. Pip ya está allí, profundamente dormido en un nido acogedor, roncando suavemente, con un ojo abriéndose.

PIP (sleepy, deadpan): "Longer than the walk, apparently."

SHOT 7 (0:28–0:30) — FINAL CLOSE-UP: Percival mira directamente a cámara, con expresión impasible, mientras sus plumas de la cola se marchitan una a una como un globo desinflándose. Golpe cómico de trombón. Aparece una tarjeta de título en elegantes letras doradas sobre el charco iluminado por la luna: "Don't let looking good stop you from getting there."

AUDIO DESIGN: banda sonora orquestal juguetona con timing cómico, cuerdas pizzicato saltarinas para Pip, metales pomposos para Percival, pasos de caricatura exagerados, salpicaduras, roce de plumas y un efecto de disco rayado cuando Percival ve el charco. Interpretación vocal expresiva de los personajes con actuaciones cómicas muy marcadas.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: destellos anamórficos en las plumas, gradación de color cálida de hora dorada que pasa a la fría luz azul de la luna, primeros planos de personajes con enfoque superficial, movimiento de cámara cómico y seguro, composición limpia con siluetas fuertes. Subsurface scattering ultradetallado en las plumas y el barro mojado, renderizado de calidad Pixar, 4K, movimiento cinematográfico a 24 fps.

fr.content:
Un court métrage d’animation 3D de 30 secondes dans le style d’un long métrage Pixar/DreamWorks — animation de personnages expressive avec squash-and-stretch, éclairage cinématographique, faible profondeur de champ, couleurs riches et saturées, lumière volumétrique douce, et rendu très détaillé des plumes et de l’environnement.

CHARACTERS: PERCIVAL, un paon magnifique et fier, avec des plumes de queue bleu-vert irisées scintillantes qui se déploient de façon spectaculaire, un plumage brillant et parfaitement soigné, des expressions théâtrales, une posture aristocratique. PIP, un petit moineau brun ébouriffé aux plumes en bataille, aux yeux vifs et confiants, avec des mouvements rapides et bondissants.

SETTING: Un sentier forestier baigné par la lumière dorée de la fin d’après-midi après la pluie. Une grande flaque de boue luisante bloque le chemin, reflétant le ciel. Végétation luxuriante, rayons de lumière à travers les arbres, particules de pollen flottantes, feuilles mouillées scintillantes.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:04) — WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT: Lent dolly-in cinématographique le long du sentier forestier. Percival entre dans le cadre en marchant d’un pas fier au ralenti, sa queue s’ouvrant comme une cape royale, les plumes captant la lumière du soleil. Accent orchestral triomphal. Il s’arrête brusquement au bord de l’immense flaque de boue. La caméra effectue un crash-zoom sur son visage horrifié.

PERCIVAL (appalled, posh accent): "A puddle?! On MY path?!"

SHOT 2 (0:04–0:10) — LOW ANGLE, over-the-puddle shot: La caméra est placée très bas, de l’autre côté de l’eau, donnant à la flaque l’apparence d’un océan. Percival la contourne avec anxiété, levant chaque patte avec délicatesse, grimaçant. Gros plan extrême sur ses plumes de queue immaculées qui frémissent à la simple vue de la boue.

PERCIVAL: "I can't cross THAT! Do you know how long these feathers take to dry?!"

SHOT 3 (0:10–0:15) — WHIP PAN vers Pip le moineau, qui atterrit sur une branche voisine, tout ébouriffé et gazouillant. Pip regarde la flaque, regarde Percival, puis hausse les épaules.

PIP (cheerful, cockney energy): "It's two feet wide, mate."

SHOT 4 (0:15–0:19) — DYNAMIC TRACKING SHOT: Pip prend son élan et saute proprement par-dessus la flaque d’un seul bond joyeux — moment au ralenti en plein vol, gouttelettes de boue scintillant autour de lui, puis il atterrit parfaitement de l’autre côté et continue sa route sans ralentir. Percival le regarde, le bec ouvert d’incrédulité.

SHOT 5 (0:19–0:24) — WIDE SHOT, dramatic angle: Percival commence le long détour AUTOUR de la flaque — la caméra s’élève et recule dans un mouvement de grue ample, révélant son détour absurde à travers les buissons, par-dessus un tronc, puis devant une famille de canards perplexes. Une musique d’aventure épique gonfle ironiquement.

PERCIVAL (marching, huffy): "A gentleman NEVER rushes!"

SHOT 6 (0:24–0:28) — NIGHT FALLS. Le même endroit, désormais éclairé par la lune, avec des lucioles lumineuses et des grillons. Percival arrive enfin, épuisé, les plumes retombantes, une feuille collée sur la tête. Pip est déjà là, profondément endormi dans un nid douillet, ronflant doucement, un œil s’ouvrant à peine.

PIP (sleepy, deadpan): "Longer than the walk, apparently."

SHOT 7 (0:28–0:30) — FINAL CLOSE-UP: Percival fixe directement la caméra, impassible, tandis que ses plumes de queue se flétrissent une à une comme un ballon qui se dégonfle. Accent comique de trombone. Un carton-titre apparaît en élégantes lettres dorées au-dessus de la flaque éclairée par la lune: "Don't let looking good stop you from getting there."

AUDIO DESIGN: musique orchestrale ludique avec un timing comique, cordes pizzicato bondissantes pour Pip, cuivres pompeux pour Percival, pas de cartoon exagérés, éclaboussures, bruissement des plumes, et un record scratch lorsque Percival voit la flaque. Jeu vocal expressif avec de grandes performances comiques.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: lens flares anamorphiques sur les plumes, étalonnage chaud de l’heure dorée évoluant vers une froide lumière bleue de lune, gros plans de personnages à faible profondeur de champ, mouvements de caméra comiques assurés, composition épurée avec silhouettes marquées. Subsurface scattering ultra-détaillé sur les plumes et la boue humide, rendu de qualité Pixar, 4K, mouvement cinématographique 24 fps.

ja.content:
30秒の3Dアニメーション短編映画。Pixar/DreamWorks作品のようなスタイルで、表情豊かな squash-and-stretch のキャラクターアニメーション、シネマティックなライティング、浅い被写界深度、豊かで鮮やかな色彩、柔らかな volumetric light、そして羽毛と環境の高精細な描写。

CHARACTERS: PERCIVAL, shimmeringする青緑の尾羽を持ち、堂々と大きく扇状に広がる magnificent で誇り高い孔雀。艶やかで完璧に手入れされており、演劇的な表情、貴族的な姿勢。PIP, 乱れた羽毛の小さくみすぼらしい茶色のスズメ。明るく自信に満ちた目、素早く弾むような動き。

SETTING: 雨上がりの、夕方の光に照らされた森の小道。大きくぬかるんだ水たまりが道をふさぎ、空を映してきらめいている。生い茂る緑、木々の間から差し込む god rays、漂う花粉の粒子、きらきら光る濡れた葉。

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:04) — WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT: 森の小道に沿って、ゆっくりとシネマティックに dolly-in。Percival がスローモーションで画面に入ってきて、尾羽を王家のマントのように大きく広げ、羽が陽光を受けて輝く。勝利を告げるオーケストラの sting。彼は巨大なぬかるんだ水たまりの縁で突然立ち止まる。カメラが彼の恐怖に満ちた顔へ crash-zoom する。

PERCIVAL (appalled, posh accent): "A puddle?! On MY path?!"

SHOT 2 (0:04–0:10) — LOW ANGLE, over-the-puddle shot: カメラは水面すれすれの低い位置にあり、水たまりを海のように見せる。Percival は不安げにその周りを回り、一本ずつ足を慎重に持ち上げながら、顔をしかめる。泥を目にしただけで震える、完璧な尾羽の extreme close-up。

PERCIVAL: "I can't cross THAT! Do you know how long these feathers take to dry?!"

SHOT 3 (0:10–0:15) — WHIP PAN で、近くの枝に着地する Pip のスズメへ。羽は少し乱れているが、元気いっぱい。Pip は水たまりを見て、Percival を見て、肩をすくめる。

PIP (cheerful, cockney energy): "It's two feet wide, mate."

SHOT 4 (0:15–0:19) — DYNAMIC TRACKING SHOT: Pip は助走をつけ、ひと跳ねで水たまりをきれいに飛び越える。空中のスローモーションでは泥のしずくが周囲でキラキラ輝き、そのまま反対側に完璧に着地して、歩調を乱さず歩き続ける。Percival は口を開けたまま、信じられないという表情で見つめる。

SHOT 5 (0:19–0:24) — WIDE SHOT, dramatic angle: Percival は水たまりを AROUND して長い道のりを歩き始める。カメラは sweeping な crane shot で上昇し後退し、茂みを抜け、倒木を越え、困惑したアヒルの家族のそばを通る、あまりにも遠回りな迂回路を明らかにする。壮大な冒険音楽が皮肉たっぷりに盛り上がる。

PERCIVAL (marching, huffy): "A gentleman NEVER rushes!"

SHOT 6 (0:24–0:28) — NIGHT FALLS. 同じ場所が、今は月明かりに照らされ、ホタルが光り、コオロギが鳴いている。Percival はついに到着するが、疲れ切って羽は垂れ下がり、頭には葉っぱが一枚くっついている。Pip はすでにそこにいて、居心地のいい巣でぐっすり眠り、静かにいびきをかきながら片目を開ける。

PIP (sleepy, deadpan): "Longer than the walk, apparently."

SHOT 7 (0:28–0:30) — FINAL CLOSE-UP: Percival がカメラをまっすぐ見つめ、deadpan のまま、尾羽がしぼんだ風船のように一本ずつしおれていく。コミカルな trombone の sting。月明かりの水たまりの上に、上品な金文字でタイトルカードが現れる: "Don't let looking good stop you from getting there."

AUDIO DESIGN: コミカルなタイミングの効いた遊び心あるオーケストラスコア。Pip には弾む pizzicato strings、Percival には大げさな brass、誇張されたカートゥーン風の足音、水しぶき、羽音、そして Percival が水たまりを見た瞬間の record-scratch。大げさで表情豊かなキャラクターボイス演技。

CINEMATOGRAPHY: 羽毛に入る anamorphic lens flares、暖かな夕暮れのカラ―グレーディングから冷たい青い月光への移行、浅いフォーカスのキャラクター close-up、自信に満ちたコメディ的なカメラワーク、強いシルエットを活かしたクリーンな構図。羽毛と濡れた泥に対する超高精細な subsurface scattering、Pixar品質のレンダリング、4K、24fps のシネマティックなモーション。

SETTING: 비가 그친 뒤 황금빛 골든아워 햇살이 비추는 숲길. 반짝이는 커다란 진흙 웅덩이가 길을 막고 있으며 하늘을 비춘다. 울창한 초록 식생, 나무 사이로 쏟아지는 god rays, 떠다니는 꽃가루 입자, 반짝이는 젖은 잎사귀.

PERCIVAL (appalled, posh accent): "A puddle?! On MY path?!"

SHOT 2 (0:04–0:10) — LOW ANGLE, over-the-puddle shot: 카메라는 물 위 낮은 위치에 자리해 웅덩이를 바다처럼 보이게 만든다. Percival은 불안하게 웅덩이를 빙빙 돌며, 발을 하나하나 조심스럽게 들어 올리고 얼굴을 찡그린다. 진흙을 보기만 해도 떨리는 그의 흠잡을 데 없는 꼬리깃을 극단적인 클로즈업으로 잡는다.

PERCIVAL: "I can't cross THAT! Do you know how long these feathers take to dry?!"

SHOT 3 (0:10–0:15) — WHIP PAN to Pip the sparrow landing on a nearby branch, 헝클어졌지만 재잘거린다. Pip은 웅덩이를 보고, Percival을 보고, 어깨를 으쓱한다.

PIP (cheerful, cockney energy): "It's two feet wide, mate."

SHOT 4 (0:15–0:19) — DYNAMIC TRACKING SHOT: Pip이 달려서 힘을 모은 뒤, 즐거운 한 번의 도약으로 웅덩이를 깔끔하게 뛰어넘는다 — 공중에서의 슬로모션 순간, 주변으로 진흙 물방울이 반짝이고, 반대편에 완벽하게 착지한 뒤 속도를 전혀 늦추지 않고 그대로 걸어간다. Percival은 입을 벌린 채 믿을 수 없다는 듯 바라본다.

SHOT 5 (0:19–0:24) — WIDE SHOT, dramatic angle: Percival이 웅덩이를 빙 돌아가는 긴 여정을 시작한다 — 카메라는 위로 올라가며 뒤로 물러나는 sweeping crane shot으로, 덤불을 지나고, 통나무를 넘고, 당황한 오리 가족 옆을 스쳐 가는 그의 터무니없이 긴 우회로를 드러낸다. 장대한 모험 음악이 아이러니하게 고조된다.

PERCIVAL (marching, huffy): "A gentleman NEVER rushes!"

SHOT 6 (0:24–0:28) — NIGHT FALLS. 같은 장소가 이제는 달빛에 잠기고, 반딧불이 빛나며, 귀뚜라미 소리가 들린다. Percival은 마침내 도착하지만 지쳐 있고, 깃털은 축 처져 있으며, 머리에는 나뭇잎 하나가 붙어 있다. Pip은 이미 그곳에 있어 아늑한 둥지에서 깊이 잠들어 있고, 조용히 코를 골며 한쪽 눈을 뜬다.

PIP (sleepy, deadpan): "Longer than the walk, apparently."

SHOT 7 (0:28–0:30) — FINAL CLOSE-UP: Percival이 카메라를 정면으로 바라보며 무표정하게 응시한다. 꼬리깃은 바람 빠지는 풍선처럼 하나씩 시들어간다. 코믹한 트롬본 스팅. 달빛 비치는 웅덩이 위로 우아한 금색 글씨의 타이틀 카드가 나타난다: "Don't let looking good stop you from getting there."

AUDIO DESIGN: 유쾌한 오케스트라 스코어와 코믹한 타이밍, Pip을 위한 경쾌한 pizzicato strings, Percival을 위한 거만한 brass, 과장된 만화풍 발소리, 물튀김, 깃털 스치는 소리, 그리고 Percival이 웅덩이를 보는 순간의 record-scratch. 과장된 코믹 연기를 살린 표현력 있는 캐릭터 보이스 연기.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: 깃털 위의 anamorphic lens flares, 따뜻한 골든아워 컬러 그레이딩이 차가운 푸른 달빛으로 전환, 얕은 초점의 캐릭터 클로즈업, 자신감 있는 코믹 카메라 무빙, 강한 실루엣이 돋보이는 깔끔한 구도. 깃털과 젖은 진흙에 대한 초고해상도 subsurface scattering, Pixar급 렌더링, 4K, 24fps 시네마틱 모션.

pt.content:
Um curta-metragem animado em 3D de 30 segundos no estilo de um longa da Pixar/DreamWorks — animação de personagens com squash-and-stretch expressivo, iluminação cinematográfica, profundidade de campo rasa, cores ricas e saturadas, luz volumétrica suave e renderização altamente detalhada das penas e do ambiente.

PERSONAGENS: PERCIVAL, um magnífico pavão orgulhoso com penas da cauda azul-esverdeadas iridescentes e cintilantes que se abrem de forma dramática, brilhantes e perfeitamente cuidadas, expressões teatrais, postura aristocrática. PIP, um pequeno pardal marrom desgrenhado com penas bagunçadas, olhos vivos e confiantes, movimentos rápidos e saltitantes.

CENÁRIO: Uma trilha de floresta iluminada pela golden hour após a chuva. Uma grande poça de lama brilhante bloqueia o caminho, refletindo o céu. Vegetação exuberante, god rays atravessando as árvores, partículas de pólen flutuando, folhas molhadas cintilando.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:04) — PLANO GERAL DE ABERTURA: Slow cinematic dolly-in ao longo da trilha da floresta. Percival entra em cena desfilando em câmera lenta, a cauda se abrindo como uma capa real, as penas captando a luz do sol. Sting orquestral triunfante. Ele para abruptamente na beira da enorme poça de lama. A câmera dá um crash-zoom em seu rosto horrorizado.

PERCIVAL (appalled, posh accent): "A puddle?! On MY path?!"

SHOT 2 (0:04–0:10) — LOW ANGLE, over-the-puddle shot: A câmera fica baixa, do outro lado da água, fazendo a poça parecer um oceano. Percival a contorna ansiosamente, levantando cada pata com delicadeza, fazendo caretas. Extreme close-up nas penas impecáveis da cauda tremendo só de ver a lama.

PERCIVAL: "I can't cross THAT! Do you know how long these feathers take to dry?!"

SHOT 3 (0:10–0:15) — WHIP PAN para Pip, o pardal, pousando em um galho próximo, desgrenhado e tagarela. Pip olha para a poça, olha para Percival, dá de ombros.

PIP (cheerful, cockney energy): "It's two feet wide, mate."

SHOT 4 (0:15–0:19) — DYNAMIC TRACKING SHOT: Pip toma impulso correndo e salta limpo sobre a poça em um único pulo alegre — momento em câmera lenta no ar, gotas de lama brilhando ao redor dele, depois pousa perfeitamente do outro lado e continua andando sem perder o ritmo. Percival observa, de bico aberto, incrédulo.

SHOT 5 (0:19–0:24) — PLANO GERAL, ângulo dramático: Percival começa a longa caminhada AO REDOR da poça — a câmera sobe e recua em um sweeping crane shot revelando seu desvio absurdamente longo por entre arbustos, sobre um tronco, passando por uma família confusa de patos. Música épica de aventura cresce ironicamente.

PERCIVAL (marching, huffy): "A gentleman NEVER rushes!"

SHOT 6 (0:24–0:28) — A NOITE CAI. O mesmo local, agora iluminado pela lua, vaga-lumes brilhando, grilos. Percival finalmente chega, exausto, penas caídas, uma folha presa na cabeça. Pip já está lá, dormindo profundamente em um ninho aconchegante, roncando de leve, com um olho se abrindo.

PIP (sleepy, deadpan): "Longer than the walk, apparently."

SHOT 7 (0:28–0:30) — CLOSE-UP FINAL: Percival encara diretamente a câmera, impassível, enquanto as penas da cauda murcham uma a uma como um balão esvaziando. Sting cômico de trombone. Um title card aparece em elegante lettering dourado sobre a poça iluminada pela lua: "Don't let looking good stop you from getting there."

DESIGN DE ÁUDIO: trilha orquestral divertida com timing cômico, cordas pizzicato saltitantes para Pip, metais pomposos para Percival, passos de desenho animado exagerados, respingos, farfalhar de penas e um scratch de vinil quando Percival vê a poça. Dublagem expressiva dos personagens com performances cômicas marcantes.

CINEMATOGRAFIA: anamorphic lens flares nas penas, color grade quente de golden hour migrando para o azul frio do luar, close-ups de personagens com foco raso, movimentação de câmera cômica confiante, composição limpa com silhuetas fortes. Subsurface scattering ultradetalhado nas penas e na lama molhada, renderização em qualidade Pixar, 4K, movimento cinematográfico em 24fps.

角色：PERCIVAL，一只华丽而骄傲的孔雀，闪耀着虹彩蓝绿色的尾羽，尾羽夸张地展开，光泽亮丽、打理得一丝不苟，表情戏剧化，姿态高贵。PIP，一只小小的、毛茸茸的棕色麻雀，羽毛凌乱，眼神明亮自信，动作轻快活泼。

场景：雨后金色时刻阳光照耀的森林小径。一大滩闪闪发亮的泥泞水坑挡住了去路，倒映着天空。郁郁葱葱的绿植，树间穿透的耶稣光，漂浮的花粉颗粒，湿润的叶片闪闪发光。

镜头 1（0:00–0:04）——大全景建立镜头：沿着森林小径缓慢电影式推进。Percival 慢动作昂首阔步进入画面，尾羽像王室披风般华丽展开，羽毛捕捉着阳光。胜利感十足的管弦乐重音。他在巨大的泥水坑边缘突然停下。镜头猛地推近到他惊恐的脸上。

PERCIVAL（震惊，贵族腔）："A puddle?! On MY path?!"

镜头 2（0:04–0:10）——低角度、越过水坑的镜头：镜头贴着水面低位拍摄，让水坑看起来像一片海洋。Percival 焦虑地绕着它转，每一步都小心翼翼，表情扭曲。极近特写聚焦在他那完美无瑕的尾羽，仅仅看到泥巴就微微发抖。

PERCIVAL："I can't cross THAT! Do you know how long these feathers take to dry?!"

镜头 3（0:10–0:15）——快速摇镜转向 Pip：麻雀 Pip 落在附近的一根树枝上，羽毛蓬乱，叽叽喳喳。Pip 看看水坑，又看看 Percival，耸耸肩。

PIP（轻快，带 cockney 气质）："It's two feet wide, mate."

镜头 4（0:15–0:19）——动态跟拍镜头：Pip 助跑起跳，轻松一跃干净利落地跨过水坑——空中慢动作瞬间，泥点在他周围闪闪发亮，然后他完美落到另一边，毫不停顿地继续往前走。Percival 张着嘴，难以置信地看着。

镜头 5（0:19–0:24）——大全景，戏剧化角度：Percival 开始绕着水坑走上漫长的一大圈——镜头以 sweeping crane shot 拉高并后移，展示他荒谬得离谱的绕路：穿过灌木、跨过树干、经过一群困惑的鸭子。史诗级冒险音乐带着讽刺意味地高涨。

PERCIVAL（边走边抱怨，气呼呼地）："A gentleman NEVER rushes!"

镜头 6（0:24–0:28）——夜幕降临。同一个地点，如今沐浴在月光下，萤火虫闪烁，蟋蟀鸣叫。Percival 终于赶到，筋疲力尽，羽毛耷拉着，头上还粘着一片叶子。Pip 已经在那儿了，正睡在舒适的鸟巢里，轻轻打鼾，一只眼睛睁开。

PIP（困倦，面无表情）："Longer than the walk, apparently."

镜头 7（0:28–0:30）——最终特写：Percival 直视镜头，面无表情，尾羽一根根像漏气的气球一样逐渐萎靡。喜剧性的长号音效。标题卡以优雅的金色字体出现在月光下的水坑上方："Don't let looking good stop you from getting there."

音频设计：轻松俏皮的管弦乐配乐，带有喜剧节奏；Pip 使用活泼跳跃的 pizzicato 弦乐；Percival 配以夸张做作的铜管乐；卡通化的脚步声、溅水声、羽毛摩擦声，以及 Percival 看到水坑时的唱片刮擦音效。角色配音富有表现力，喜剧表演夸张到位。

摄影：羽毛上的变形宽银幕镜头光晕，温暖的金色时刻调色逐渐过渡到冷蓝色月光，浅景深角色特写，自信的喜剧镜头运动，构图干净，剪影鲜明。羽毛和湿泥具有超细致的次表面散射，Pixar 级渲染，4K，24fps 电影级运动。
